code:
from sklearn.metrics import cohen_kappa_score

# Two annotators' pairwise-preference labels, same 100 examples
annotator_a = [0, 1, 1, 0, 1, ...]
annotator_b = [0, 1, 0, 0, 1, ...]

kappa = cohen_kappa_score(annotator_a, annotator_b)
# kappa > 0.6 -- substantial agreement
caption: Kappa corrects for chance agreement -- raw percent-agreement doesn't.
